summary: Iteration 10 covered ElevenLabs as the primary TTS with OpenAI tts-1 as fallback, plus a regression of the latency/dialog work. Backend: 16/16 new tests pass (tests/test_iter10_elevenlabs.py, against the public URL) and the existing 15/15 pass (test_iter7_latency + test_iter9_dialog). (1) /api/health reports providers.tts='elevenlabs'. (2) The speak=true chain in one session works. 'find me a truck stop' -> route_set 'Route set to ...' with mp3 audio. 'how far is it?' -> chat that uses the route numbers. 'not that one' -> route_set to a different place id. 'bye' -> chat with end_conversation=true. Every turn has llm_round_1, tts and total in timings. ElevenLabs tts per turn was 315/236/301/113 ms, and turn totals were 2371/951/1004/802 ms. (3) The 2-sentence reply to 'how far is it and where do I park?' returned audio_url and audio_url_2, and both serve 200 audio/mpeg (valid mp3 frames). (4) /api/speak: repeating the same text returns the same id (0.45s first call, 0.13s cached). voice=nova/model=tts-1 and model=gpt-4o-mini-tts give a different cache entry with valid audio. Empty text and an invalid voice return 422. An unknown audio id returns 404. (5) /api/speak 'Take me to Reno.' -> mp3 -> /api/voice/transcribe gives a transcript containing 'Reno' -> /api/agent?speak=true gives route_set 'Route to Reno is set: 2 h 50 min, 132 miles.' (6) Legacy /api/voice multipart returns route_set with stt/llm_round_1/tts/total timings. (7) /api/warm returns {ok:true} in under 3s, and lat=999 returns 422. (8) Fallback probe run in-process: a real key uses ElevenLabs (263 ms). key='sk_invalid' gets a 401, logs the warning 'ElevenLabs TTS 401, falling back to OpenAI' and returns tts-1 mp3 (2.7s). An unreachable URL logs 'ElevenLabs TTS failed, falling back' and returns audio. With the key unset, provider() is 'openai'. Frontend smoke at 390x844: onboarding loads (onboarding /api/speak calls all 200). After Skip, the map shows 'Where to next?' / 'Tap to talk' and /api/warm returns 200. No console errors. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) and no SafeAreaView issues found.

minor.issue: When ElevenLabs fails and OpenAI is used, the fallback audio is still cached under the 'elevenlabs|<voice>' key. After one transient ElevenLabs error, that fixed line (onboarding, break reminder, parking tip) is spoken in the OpenAI 'sage' voice until a restart or cache eviction. Have synthesize() report which provider produced the audio, and skip caching (or cache under the openai tag) when it fell back.

There is no circuit breaker. A 401 or quota error is fast (~0.3s), but if ElevenLabs hangs or is down, every sentence waits up to ELEVEN_TIMEOUT_S=8s before falling back. That adds about 8s to each voice turn and to each /speak call. Consider a cooldown (skip ElevenLabs for ~60s after a failure) and/or a lower timeout (~3s), since flash normally answers in ~250 ms.
If only one sentence falls back, the two halves of a reply are spoken in different voices (ElevenLabs Rachel and OpenAI sage). A cooldown would make this mostly go away.

action_items: Optional: don't cache /api/speak results produced by the OpenAI fallback under the ElevenLabs cache key.
Optional: add an ElevenLabs failure cooldown (circuit breaker) and/or reduce the 8s timeout so outages don't add up to 8s per sentence.
Trivial: update the voice.py module docstring (it still says 'OpenAI TTS'), and add the missing blank lines between _eleven and INSTRUCTIONS (voice.py:98-99).
critical_code_review_comments: _eleven matches the spec: output_format=mp3_22050_32, model eleven_flash_v2_5, stability 0.5 / similarity 0.75 / speed 1.05, 8s timeout, shared httpx client, xi-api-key header. Any exception, non-200 or empty body returns None, and the caller falls back to tts-1/sage.
An explicit voice or model in /api/speak bypasses ElevenLabs, so the OpenAI comparison path is intact. The cache_tag includes provider and voice_id.
/api/health providers.tts only reflects configuration (whether a key is present), not whether ElevenLabs is actually reachable or authorized.
API keys are never logged. The warning logs only the status and the first 200 chars of the ElevenLabs error body.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Created in-memory TEST_ session ids and TEST /speak lines.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<public url> python -m pytest -q -n 0 tests/test_iter10_elevenlabs.py. The fallback probe is: python tests/probe_iter10_tts_fallback.py (it changes env in-process only; it prints the cache_tag, which includes the voice id). The Reno mp3 is generated through /api/speak, so no fixture file is needed. A fresh browser shows onboarding; tap onboarding-skip-button to reach the map ('Tap to talk').
